CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

2. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

15. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
